args.description: Motor mount; y up. Four bottom washer footprints idealized as fully clamped to a rigid bed. Solid 24 mm diameter x 10 mm bosses; no explicit bolt holes. Solid 40 x 40 x 5 mm motor pad lies inside the envelope at y=55..60. Simultaneous uniformly distributed motor forces: +0.8 kN x and -2 kN y. Isotropic linear elasticity E=69 GPa, nu=0.33.

args.note: Brief gives millimetres and kilonewtons; use mm and kN (elastic modulus in kN/mm^2).
160 x 60 x 120 mm (x,y,z), y up; bottom face y=0, origin at minimum corner.
Aluminium 6061 is stated; isotropic linear-elastic E=69 kN/mm^2 (69 GPa) and nu=0.33 are assumed because no elastic constants or temper are specified.
Brief specifies 0.2; tool applies this to the non-passive design volume, excluding prescribed solid bosses and motor pad.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.
M10 bolt connection idealized as fully fixed over the 24 mm washer footprint on y=0; rigid machine bed; bolt bore not explicitly meshed.
